title: Custom Search Shortcuts
tagline: A Chrome extension for customizable right-click search shortcuts.
description: A Chrome extension that adds customizable search shortcuts to your right-click context menu. Quickly search selected text across multiple search engines and websites with support for environment variables and dynamic URL templates.

features.title: Core Features
features.description: Custom search engines, environment variables, dynamic URL templates with {{variable}} syntax, right-click integration.

features.title: Organization
features.description: Categories with emoji icons, drag-and-drop reordering, context menu separators, nested submenus.

features.title: Favorites
features.description: Pin shortcuts to top of context menu and popup. Toggle favorites from options page. Category-aware pinning.

features.title: Productivity
features.description: Duplicate shortcuts, popup quick access, new tab positioning, import/export configs.

features.title: Safety
features.description: Trash with undo delete (Gmail-style), configurable retention, one-click restore.

features.title: Appearance
features.description: Dark/light/system theme toggle. Settings page for theme, trash retention, tab position, and default category.

sections.heading: How It Works
sections.content: Install the extension, add your favorite search engines and websites, and right-click any selected text to instantly search across them. Use environment variables and dynamic URL templates for powerful, context-aware searches.

sections.heading: Tech Stack
sections.content: Built with Chrome Extension Manifest V3, vanilla JavaScript, Chrome Storage API, and Context Menu API. No external frameworks — lightweight and fast.

title: Tab Manager
tagline: A Kanban-based Chrome extension to organize and manage browser tabs.
description: A Chrome extension to manage browser tabs with a Kanban board, project grouping, drag-and-drop, and workflow states. Includes a dashboard, archive, trash, auto-snapshots, and full export/import.

features.title: Kanban Dashboard
features.description: Organize tab groups into configurable workflow state columns (e.g., Backlog → In Progress → Review → Done) with drag-and-drop.

features.title: Tab Groups
features.description: Create named groups with colors, drag open tabs into groups, and open all tabs in a group with one click.

features.title: Auto-Snapshot & Sessions
features.description: Save/restore sessions, periodic automatic tab backups, configurable snapshot interval and retention.

features.title: Trash & Archive
features.description: Deleted groups go to trash with 15-day retention. Archived groups can be restored anytime. Export/import as JSON.

features.title: Stats & Detection
features.description: Live stats for tabs, groups, windows, and duplicate count. Duplicate tabs are highlighted with a yellow DUP badge.

features.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
features.description: Ctrl+S to save, N to focus new group, / to search, R to refresh tabs — all from the dashboard or popup.

sections.heading: How It Works
sections.content: Use the popup to quickly add tabs to groups, or open the full Kanban dashboard to drag tabs between workflow columns. Configure up to 5 custom states, auto-snapshots, badge counts, and more from Settings.

sections.heading: Tech Stack
sections.content: Chrome Extension Manifest V3, vanilla JavaScript, Chrome Storage API. Features a multi-page architecture with popup, dashboard, archive, trash, and settings pages.

title: TabStack
tagline: Stack up and launch your daily tabs with one click.
description: A Chrome extension that lets you save a list of URLs and open them all at once with a single click. Features dark/light/system theme, live URL count badge, favicon previews, and configurable tab launch behavior.

features.title: One-Click Launch
features.description: Open all your saved URLs at once with a single click — in a new window or existing window.

features.title: Editable URL List
features.description: Manage your URLs one per line with comment support (lines starting with #). Only http/https URLs are accepted.

features.title: URL Preview
features.description: Live favicon previews in the popup so you can see what you're about to open before launching.

features.title: Theme & UX
features.description: Dark/light/system theme toggle, toast notifications, live URL count badge, and modern card-based UI with toggle switches.

sections.heading: How It Works
sections.content: Add your daily URLs to the list, configure launch settings (new window, delay between tabs, focus first tab), and click Open Tabs. Settings sync across devices via chrome.storage.sync.

sections.heading: Tech Stack
sections.content: Chrome Extension Manifest V3, vanilla JavaScript, Chrome Storage Sync API. No external frameworks — lightweight and fast.
